content: Task ledger update: Hermes Discord operating-room interaction receipts deployed. Added redacted operating-room slash command receipts for /plans, /tasks, /task, /review, /continue, /council, and /gateway. Receipts write annunimas.hermes.discord_operating_room_interaction.v1 to data/hermes/discord_operating_room_interactions.jsonl and intentionally omit option values and response content. Updated the canonical plan, runbook, and activation check to verify this proof surface. Built release and restarted annunimas-hermes-discord.service after approval; service is active and reconnected as Annunimas_CEO. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p annunimas-cli -p annunimas-hermes; cargo test -p annunimas-hermes serenity_bot -- --nocapture; cargo test -p annunimas-cli hermes_agent_gateway_activation_check -- --nocapture; cargo run -p annunimas-cli -- utility hermes-agent-gateway-activation-check reports ready_for_live_gateway/live_ready=true and interaction_receipts=data/hermes/discord_operating_room_interactions.jsonl.
